content: Saanvi Pillai called insurance agent Anita Sharma to check the status of her life insurance policy. Anita confirmed the policy is active, stated the next premium due date is 15/11/2026, discussed the option of adding a critical illness rider for an extra 0.8% of the base premium, and verified that Rajesh Pillai remains the listed beneficiary. Anita agreed to email the critical illness rider brochure to Saanvi after the call.

action_items: Email the critical illness rider brochure to the customer
